svg.title: Everything on: cutaway of a generic three-storey commercial building
svg.desc: Layered 2.5D cutaway. OSP fiber enters from a street handhole to the MDF, the riser climbs to an IDF stacked on each floor, a tray above the ceiling carries J-hooks to outlets, ceiling access points show an illustrative coverage ripple, cameras look inward from entries, corridors and parking, and readers sit on the latch-side jamb.
